headline: Stale: FDA approved Hibsago on Oct 20 at 15:50 ET; today's items are rewrites, and GSK is -1%
reasoning: The event: FDA approval of Hibsago (bepirovirsen) for chronic hepatitis B. Benzinga reported it on Oct 20 at 15:50 ET ('FDA Approves First-Of-Its-Kind Chronic Hepatitis B Treatment'); yesterday's morning run skipped that item as already traded. Today's 08:32 and 10:14 ET items ('GSK Receives US FDA Approval for Hibsago', 'GSK Wins FDA Approval For Chronic Hepatitis B Drug') are rewrites.

Quoted from today's article: the FDA 'approved GSK plc's (NYSE: GSK) Hibsago (bepirovirsen) injection to treat adult chronic hepatitis B patients without cirrhosis', under 'priority review and Breakthrough Therapy Designation'.
The approval was public before Tuesday's close and expected (priority review). GSK closed Tuesday at 50.64 (+2.3%) and is -1.0% today.
objections: Stale: approval reported Oct 20 at 15:50 ET; a full session has traded it.
